statement:
∀ (f : ℝ → ℂ) (k : ℝ),
  ∫ (y : ℝ), (starRingEnd ℂ) (f (-y)) * cexp (-(↑k * ↑y) * I) = (starRingEnd ℂ) (∫ (y : ℝ), f y * cexp (-(↑k * ↑y) * I))

goal.text: ∫ (y : ℝ), (starRingEnd ℂ) (f (-y)) * cexp (-(↑k * ↑y) * I) = (starRingEnd ℂ) (∫ (y : ℝ), f y * cexp (-(↑k * ↑y) * I))
goal.rhs: (starRingEnd ℂ) (∫ (y : ℝ), f y * cexp (-(↑k * ↑y) * I))

atoms: (starRingEnd ℂ) (∫ (y : ℝ), f y * cexp (-(↑k * ↑y) * I))

values: fun x => Complex.exp (-(x - 1 : ℂ) ^ 2 + Complex.I * x)
